supersedes: AEQ_ORACLE_PREFLIGHT_V1, rejected before execution by PREFLIGHT_V1_INVALIDATION_AUDIT.json
purpose: test strict protocol conformance, authenticated input reproducibility, class support, sampling sensitivity, and targeted semantic failure modes before any representative oracle audit
authorization_scope_if_passed: A pass authorizes design and separate approval of a larger reproducible content-blind representative audit. It does not authorize the full 1475-unit oracle.
targeted_sample_limitation: Twelve clips were selected partly from semantically different legacy strata and one known disputed location. This is a challenge/pipeline pilot, not a prevalence or accuracy sample.

input_sampling.semantics: nearest source frame to endpoint-inclusive exact-rate temporal targets
input_sampling.runtime_requirement: every decoded index and RGB content hash must exactly equal the frozen frame manifest before inference

gates.artifact_authentication: all bindings, record self-hashes, raw hashes, identity hashes, exact frames, repeat model-input identities, and runtime GPU declarations validate
gates.same_process_reproducibility: 12 of 12 identical-input pairs have exact raw-response hash equality
gates.cross_replica_reproducibility: all three anchor observations have exact model-input and raw-response hash equality
gates.sensitivity_polarity_rule: any relevant/not_relevant flip fails; any transition to/from unknown requires review
gates.semantic_screen: bidirectional model/review decided-polarity disagreements require adjudication regardless of model confidence; review unknown is never negative
gates.systematic_semantic_failure: at least two decided-polarity contradiction candidates across at least two videos
gates.claim_grounding: every model-positive cause and evidence claim requires post-output independent visual review; analyzer cannot issue final PASS before this review

failure_action: do not request a representative audit; revise the protocol or retain INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE as the eventual terminal option
pass_action: design a reproducible content-blind representative audit with separate compute approval and frozen sequential QC/stop rules
